metadata.policy: Generated manually in the isolated pinned environment; DiffPES tests consume inert numeric JSON and never import or execute Chinook or this generator.

conventions.comparator_rounding_control: the in-plane lattice constant 2*sqrt(2) A makes Chinook's 45-degree-rotated axial bonds exactly 2 A per component, so its four-decimal slab-record rounding is inactive
conventions.depth: nonnegative distance below the top orbital plane
conventions.hopping: onsite plus both directed nearest-neighbor records on each Cartesian lattice axis
conventions.kpoints: fractional coordinates of the original bulk cell
conventions.surface_weights: per-band expectations, compared only because this fixture has a simple nondegenerate spectrum
conventions.thickness: minimum top-to-bottom material span; a 15 A request on 3 A planes realizes six orbital planes
